title: The First Date
text: {crush} from next door finally said yes to dinner. {Crush.he} thinks you're “the one who waters everyone's plants when they're away”.

ok.text: {crush} laughs so hard wine comes out of {crush.his} nose. “Honest AND bad with plants.” It's a start.

effects.remember: Told {crush} the truth about the plants on your first date.

ok.text: {crush} is charmed. {Crush.he} asks for tips about {crush.his} fern. You panic quietly.

reveal.text: {friend}, two beers in, tells {crush} who really watered the plants. {crush} asks what else you've lied about. It's a long list.

effects.remember: Won {crush} over by taking credit for {friend}'s plant watering.

blabber.text: {crush} is charmed. Then you say “well, technically {friend} watered them”. Then you explain the whole plan. {crush} finds it adorable, somehow.

fail.text: You call {crush.his} fern “the green one”. {crush} gets suspicious.

ok.text: {friend} tells stories that make you sound like a hero. {crush} kisses you at the door.

effects.remember: {friend} was the best wingman of all time.

cast.did: made you sound like a hero

fail.text: {friend} is charming. Too charming. {crush} leaves with {friend}.

effects.remember: Brought {friend} as a wingman. {crush} left with {friend}.

choices.label: Notice {crush.he} keeps checking {crush.his} phone and ask what's really wrong

ok.text: {crush.he} talks about {crush.his} mother for two hours. You listen. It's the best date {crush.he}'s ever had.

effects.remember: Listened to {crush} like a professional. Free of charge.

text.text: Two years with {crush}. {Crush.his} mother still tells everyone you're “the honest one who can't keep a plant alive”. At Sunday lunch she asks, loudly, when you're making it official.
Two years with {crush}. At Sunday lunch {crush.his} mother asks, very loudly, when you're “making it official”.

choices.label: Propose right now, with an onion ring

ok.text: {crush} says yes. The onion ring lasts four days. The marriage, hopefully, longer.

effects.home: A small house with a crooked fence

effects.remember: Proposed to {crush} with an onion ring. {Crush.he} said yes.

fail.text: “Ask me properly,” says {crush}. “Or don't,” says {crush.his} mother.

choices.label: Plan a huge surprise and let {friend} organise it

ok.text: Fireworks, a brass band, a goat in a bow tie. {crush} cries. The goat eats the ring box.

effects.home: A small house with a crooked fence

fail.text: {friend} told {crush} on Tuesday. On Saturday {crush.he} acts surprised. {Crush.he} is a very bad actor.

effects.home: A small house with a crooked fence

effects.remember: {friend} spoiled the surprise proposal. {crush} said yes anyway.

choices.label: Change the subject to the weather

ok.text: You talk about rain for twenty minutes. {crush}'s mother starts knitting something. It looks like a noose.

effects.remember: Avoided the marriage question by talking about rain.

choices.label: Buy the biggest ring in the shop

ok.text: It's enormous. {crush} says yes and needs a new glove. Your bank account needs a hug.

effects.home: A small house with a crooked fence

effects.remember: Proposed with a ring the size of a doorknob.

showoff.text: It's enormous, and you announce it with a hired trumpeter. {crush} says yes. The trumpeter sends you an invoice.

effects.home: A small house with a crooked fence

choices.label: Gently ask {crush}'s mother why it matters so much to her

ok.text: She tells you about her own wedding, cries, and gives you her mother's ring. You propose that evening.

effects.home: A small house with a crooked fence

effects.remember: Got {crush}'s grandmother's ring with one good question.

title: Meet the Parents
text: {crush}'s parents invite you for dinner. Their dog hates you. Their cat hates the dog. Their son-in-law is a dentist and he's “so successful”.

ok.text: You bring sausages. The dog loves you. The parents conclude you must be good people.

effects.remember: Won over {crush}'s parents through their dog.

fail.text: The dog takes the sausages and bites you anyway. The dentist offers to look at it.

choices.label: Talk about your job like it's more important than dentistry

ok.text: They're impressed. The dentist goes quiet. {crush} kicks you under the table, lovingly.

effects.remember: Out-bragged the dentist at {crush}'s parents' dinner.

fail.text: You say “so basically I save lives”. The dentist saves lives. The table goes silent.

ok.text: {crush}'s mother takes your hand and says “finally”. Nobody knows what she means. Everybody agrees.

effects.remember: Washed up at {crush}'s parents'. Became family on the spot.

fail.text: You break the good gravy boat. It was {crush}'s grandmother's. Nobody says anything, which is worse.

lazy.text: You stand at the sink for twenty minutes holding one plate. {crush}'s mother takes it off you, very gently, like a weapon.
